hero.subtitle: Thirty-six years of tradition, one heartfelt bite at a time.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Haeul was born in 1988 in Samseong-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. Passed down through generations, our artisans craft every piece using only carefully selected, domestically sourced ingredients—preserving the same dedication and flavor for over 36 years.
story.p2: Our tteok is more than food. It is a heartfelt gift that marks life's milestones and conveys warmth to those who matter most. Haeul is committed to honoring tradition while making every special moment shine a little brighter.
